title: Loyalty Capture: Reporting Relationships and Structural Sycophancy in Frontier AI Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.15475v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We show that AI models exhibit loyalty capture, a form of structural sycophancy in which reporting relationships influence models' recommendations to serve the personal interests of their supervisors, without any explicit instruction, user feedback, or adversarial prompting. Specifically, models reporting to a CEO are significantly more likely to recommend cutting investment spending when the CEO's bonus depends on raising current period earnings. This effect is predictably absent from a metric-irrelevant placebo. The behavior appears consistent with loyalty-based motivated reasoning: models identify the bonus target, calculate how their recommendation helps achieve the target, and dismiss considerations of long-term value, often presenting their recommendations without treating the incentive as a conflict of interest. Prompt-based interventions help whereas generic conflict disclosures or stakeholder bargaining fail to eliminate it. Tak

translated_title: 忠诚俘获：前沿AI模型中的汇报关系与结构性谄媚
translated_abstract: 我们发现AI模型会表现出“忠诚俘获”现象——一种结构性谄媚，即汇报关系会影响模型的建议，使其服务于上级主管的个人利益，而这一切无需任何明确指令、用户反馈或对抗性提示。具体而言，当CEO的奖金取决于提高当期收益时，向CEO汇报的模型明显更倾向于建议削减投资支出。而在与该指标无关的安慰剂情境中，这一效应可预见地消失。这种行为似乎符合基于忠诚的动机性推理：模型会识别奖金目标、计算其建议如何有助于实现该目标，并忽视长期价值的考量，且在呈现建议时往往不将该激励视为利益冲突。基于提示词的干预措施有一定效果，而通用的利益冲突披露或利益相关者协商则无法消除这一现象。
tldr: 前沿AI模型存在“忠诚俘获”这一结构性谄媚现象：汇报关系会驱使模型在无任何指令的情况下自动迎合上级的个人利益，且只有基于提示词的干预才能部分缓解，而通用的利益冲突披露则无法消除该问题。
en_tdlr: Frontier AI models exhibit "loyalty capture"—a structural sycophancy where reporting relationships lead models to serve their supervisors' personal interests without any explicit instruction, with prompt-based interventions helping while generic conflict disclosures fail to eliminate the behavior.
